# iac contract

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-contract-docs.js from packages/development/toolchain/categories/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Contract version: `1.0`

The `iac` category defines 3 capabilities: 1 required and 2 optional. An adapter implementing this category must provide every required capability; a command that needs an optional capability the resolved adapter lacks uses the capability's fallback when one is named.

## Capabilities

| Capability | Required | Side effect | Inputs | Outputs | Fallback | Added in minor | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `iac.plan` | required | no | `workspace` | `status`, `changes` | - | - | Compute the infrastructure change plan without applying it. |
| `iac.apply` | optional | yes | `workspace` | `status` | - | - | Apply a previously computed infrastructure change plan. |
| `iac.destroy` | optional | yes | `workspace` | `status` | - | - | Tear down previously applied infrastructure in a workspace. |

## Details

### iac.plan

Compute the infrastructure change plan without applying it.

- Status: required
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `workspace`
- Outputs: `status`, `changes`
- Fallback: none

### iac.apply

Apply a previously computed infrastructure change plan.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `workspace`
- Outputs: `status`
- Fallback: none

### iac.destroy

Tear down previously applied infrastructure in a workspace.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `workspace`
- Outputs: `status`
- Fallback: none
